Eldoria Rock.authoring_rule: macro breakup first; avoid noisy microdetail that vanishes at gameplay camera

Eldoria Stone.role: walls, stairs, structural masonry, bastion architecture
Eldoria Stone.authoring_rule: read joints/AO and form at zoom 12/9; do not rely on high-frequency texture

Eldoria Timber.role: beams, frames, doors, balconies, production/residential structure
Eldoria Timber.authoring_rule: warmth is controlled; avoid orange/cartoon timber

Eldoria Roof.value_relation: one of the darkest architectural families
Eldoria Roof.authoring_rule: silhouette and value separation matter more than microdetail

Eldoria Ground.role: street, terrace, mud/stone transitions and circulation readability

rule: Asset-specific materials may vary via masks, wear and accents, but should inherit these families rather than introduce unrelated shading responses.
